{{Quote|A little help, sir?|Quo offering to light the way through [[Entyrmion]]'s tunnel for [[Halagad Ventor]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Quo''', designated '''RC-1572,''' was a [[Republic commando]] and member of the elite [[clone commando]] squad led by [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo]] known as [[Tark Squad]], which was part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[21 BBY]]. Quo was nicknamed by his genetic template and trainer [[Sarsius Torne]] after the [[Thyrsian (language)|Thyrsian letter]] for two.

==Biography==
RC-1572, who picked the name Quo, was a [[Republic commando]] and a of the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Tark Squad]]. In actuality, Quo and his squad were [[Thyrsian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] trained by Sarsius Torne of the [[Sun Guard]]s to infiltrate the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] as part of a deal made with [[Zeta Magnus]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to recover [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. To ensure obedience Quo was implanted with a cybernetic control band. In [[21 BBY]], Quo and his squad were sent to assist [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in liberating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye]] from Zeta Magnus while disguised as a relief team.

Quo and the rest of the liberation team snuck into [[Kharys' fortress|Zeta Magnus' fortress]] through [[Entyrmion]]'s subterranean tunnel system located beneath the fortress.While in the cave, the liberation team was attacked by multiple [[Oskan blood eater]]s created by Zeta Magnus which killed many of their [[S'kytri]] guides as well as the Lord of the S'kytri [[Highland Clan]]s, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Klarymére]]. The commando squad was able to kill the blood eaters with a [[Class-D detonator]] which angered Obi-Wan, as he believed it was ''"affront to the force"''. When the liberation team arrived in Zeta Magnus' fortress, Quo and the rest of Tark Squad led the Jedi commanders into a field of [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]s. Quo and his squad revealed to the [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] that they were allied with Zeta Magnus and left them to be [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by Zeta Magnus and his [[Blue-Tark/Legends|torture droid]]. Quo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fortress by [[Halagad Ventor]] when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] beheaded him with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]].

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Our armor is environmentally controlled, General.|Captain Nilo to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on his squads [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn Armor]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Quo wore specialized [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn-class commando armor]] with a silver finish like the rest of his squad. Quo used a [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] interchangeable rifle with a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|Grappling spike launcher]] attachment.
